text:
I’ve had a string of awful experiences at this dental clinic. Would not recommend.

A few months ago, I came in for a simple cleaning and they damaged one of my existing fillings during the appointment. That alone should’ve been a huge red flag.

The second time I returned, I clearly asked for three things:
1.	the damaged filling to be repaired,
2.	a cleaning,
3.	and simply the whitening kit — not an in-office whitening treatment, just the kit.

Instead, they told me that I “shouldn’t” do the fillings now and insisted they had to be done after whitening, even though I explained repeatedly that these fillings are not visible at all. They still refused to listen.

They then told me to arrive early for my appointment, which I did — and yet they still didn’t do the fillings, even though that was one of the main reasons I came. The cleaning they performed was also extremely painful and felt completely wrong. I had to ask them several times to stop because it hurt so much. They didn’t stop the first time I asked; I had to insist before they finally did.

Despite being early, despite the fillings being small and straightforward, and despite explaining everything clearly, they did not finish the work and told me to come back yet again.

And now here I am at the next appointment — and they’re already 30 minutes late. Add to that the difficulty of making even a basic appointment and it’s just been a nightmare from start to finish.

Based on how many issues I’ve had here, I absolutely would not recommend this clinic to anyone.

text: First of all, I have to say I'm terrified of dentists. Lately, I've had symptoms like my teeth were falling out, they were all loose, I had cavities everywhere, and I've been experiencing unexplained migraine headaches. I also had lead fillings on three molars (two on the innermost upper jaws and one on the lower jaw). After enduring it for so long, I finally went to the dentist. Ultimately, I needed root canal treatment on two upper right molars (they removed the fillings and redid the rest), and another on the left. I was terrified, but unbelievably, the dentist was incredibly gentle, kind, and careful not to let anything go into my throat. Dr. Jirihathai, a small female dentist, was like a goddess to me. I expected the injection to hurt, but it didn't at all. When she drilled the root canal, it felt so comfortable, like someone was massaging my nerves. That's when I realized my migraines were coming from my inflamed root canals. When she treated the other root canal, I felt so much better. The migraine pain in my forehead, left eye socket, and back of my head disappeared completely. I finally understood that the left-sided migraines I'd been experiencing for ten years, taking painkillers daily, were actually caused by inflamed root canals. The dentist was excellent. They were quick, gentle, and meticulous, ensuring no saliva or debris entered my throat. For me, being a dentist isn't just about skill; compassion and care are equally important. I give them a perfect 10/10 for skill, a perfect 10/10 for care and attention to detail, and a perfect 10/100 for making me overcome my fear of dentists. Dr. Peerapat also did my crown, which is beautiful and incredibly detailed. My tooth was crooked, and he carefully prepared around it to prevent me from biting my cheek. I'm allergic to lead, and he was wonderful. When he removed the silver filling, my tooth cracked, but he secured it and crowned it after the root canal treatment. I was very worried about lead leaking into my throat, but it was perfectly fine. There was also Dr. Sornsiri, a male dentist, who helped remove the silver lead fillings from both lower molars. He worked very quickly and painlessly. The fillings turned out beautifully. He was very attentive, preparing the crooked tooth that I couldn't reach to make using a dental floss easier. He even used a rubber gauze to prevent any debris from entering my throat during the procedure. His attentiveness and explanations made me feel comfortable lying with my mouth open for the treatment. I want to express my sincere gratitude. This is a genuine review. I paid for everything myself; no one paid for it, and there were no discounts. But I really liked the treatment I received here and am very thankful for it, which is why I'm writing this review. Thank you, Dr. Jirihathai, for helping me overcome my fear of dentists. Thank you also to Dr. Peerapat and Dr. Sornsiri. This is Walirat.
